name: harvest
title_zh: 干完活顺手把通用解法收进工具箱的收成夹
tagline_zh: 调试完、合完 PR、踩完坑，一句「harvest this」就把刚悟到的解法沉淀成 Kit 条目。
tagline_en: After debugging, merging, or hitting a wall, say "harvest this" and turn your hard-won fix into a reusable Kit.
desc_en: Use when working in a Project and something turns out to belong in the Kit instead - "harvest this", "/harvest", "file that as a Lesson", "the Kit should do this" - or at a phase boundary after implementing, after reviewing a Loop PR, or after debugging.
why_zh: 它把「沉淀」从额外任务变成收尾动作——在项目上下文还热的时候抓取，而不是事后凭记忆补。
why_en: It turns "documenting" from a chore into a closing ritual—captures while context is hot, not from memory later. Targets phase.
limit_zh: 只在你有 Project 和 Kit 双结构时生效；它收的是「可复用解法/教训」，不是代码片段或依赖清单。
limit_en: Only works when you have both a Project and a Kit structure; it harvests reusable lessons, not code snippets or dependency lists. Without a defined.
title_en: Harvest reusable lessons into your kit as you finish work
